problem_statement: Return a new dictionary with keys and values of d swapped: each value v in d becomes a key in the result mapping to its original key. When multiple original keys share the same value, the last key encountered in dictionary iteration order wins in the inverted result. d is a Python dictionary with string keys and string values. Do not modify the input.
